t: One Step Up - Wikipedia
s: 3 weeks ago - "One Step Up" is a song by the American singer-songwriter Bruce Springsteen from his eighth studio album, Tunnel of Love (1987). It was released as the third single from the album, following "Brilliant Disguise" and the title track. It reached position #13 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart, #3 on the Adult Contemporary chart in the United States, and #23 in Canada.
